name: auth-failure
description: The documented real-world auth failure: an expired or invalid access_token cookie does not produce a 401 -- the portal answers with its login page, a 200 whose body is HTML. json-decoding that used to abort the task with a decode error and, because reporting was deferred to the end of the run, nothing at all was imported. The walk must instead end with a clean log line naming the likely expired cookie, import zero assets, and make exactly one request (a 200 is not a retryable status, so the built-in retries must not fire).  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.

responses.text: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Sign in</title></head><body><form action="/login" method="post"><input name="username"><input name="password" type="password"></form></body></html>

log_contains: cyberint: page 1 returned a non-JSON body; the access token cookie is likely expired or invalid
error_contains: the access token cookie is likely expired or invalid
